game_title: Accumulator Pump – Dragon Hoard Cave Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Accumulator Pump: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Dragon Hoard Cave, repeat each round: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the total value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the crystal door using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The crystal door reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the crystal door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Accumulator Pump
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
